title: Why China’s industrial policy is winning
gist: Video page in which Adam Tooze argues China's industrial policy is winning; the captured text contains no transcript, only the headline and related FP coverage on NATO expansion and Ukraine's war strategy and drone innovation.

insights.claim: Adam Tooze argues in a July 2026 Foreign Policy video that China's industrial policy is winning.
insights.speaker: Adam Tooze
insights.so_what: Supports the case that state-directed Chinese manufacturing will keep gaining global share in strategic sectors.
insights.locator: Why China’s industrial policy is winning

insights.claim: Related Foreign Policy coverage argues Washington should not fear NATO expansion because new allies bring powerful military assets, regardless of Donald Trump's views.
insights.speaker: Adam Tooze
insights.so_what: A stronger, larger NATO supports sustained European defense spending.
insights.quote: New allies bring powerful assets—whatever Donald Trump thinks.

insights.claim: Related Foreign Policy coverage examines whether Ukraine's decentralized drone innovation is a passing blip or a lasting military revolution.
insights.speaker: Adam Tooze
insights.so_what: Decentralized drone production could reshape defense procurement toward cheap, iterative systems.
insights.locator: Is Ukraine’s Decentralized Drone Innovation a Blip or a Revolution?
